title: A letter to myself in one year
message:
Dear me,
it is the end of October 2026. I am learning how to build websites, and today I made my very first capsule.
I hope that by the time you read this, the project is finished and defended. Remember how nervous you were? Be kind to yourself.

title: New Year wishes for the group
message:
Happy New Year, everyone!
I wish all of us fewer deadlines, more sleep and projects that work on the first try.

title: Before graduation
message:
By the time you read this, the exams are over.
Write down three things you are proud of from this year.

title: First week of the course
message:
Hi, future me.
Today I started the web programming course and I still don’t know how a server works. I hope that by the time you read this, you can build one.
